messages.content: Write REXX to submit a job and wait for it to complete on z/OS

Here's REXX to submit a job and monitor its completion:

```rexx
/* REXX - Submit job and wait for completion */
ARG jcl_dsn

IF jcl_dsn = '' THEN DO
   SAY 'Usage: SUBJOB dsn.name(member)'
   EXIT 4
END

/* Submit the job */
"SUBMIT '"jcl_dsn"'"
IF RC \= 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Submit failed, RC=' RC
   EXIT 8
END

/* Capture the job number from submit message */
CALL OUTTRAP 'MSG.'
"SUBMIT '"jcl_dsn"'"
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

/* Parse job number from JOB nnnn SUBMITTED message */
jobnum = ''
DO i = 1 TO MSG.0
   IF POS('SUBMITTED', MSG.i) > 0 THEN DO
      PARSE VAR MSG.i . 'JOB' jobnum .
      jobnum = STRIP(jobnum)
      LEAVE
   END
END

IF jobnum = '' THEN DO
   SAY 'Could not determine job number'
   EXIT 8
END

SAY 'Job' jobnum 'submitted, waiting for completion...'

/* Poll for job completion */
max_wait = 300  /* 5 minutes max */
wait_time = 0
interval = 5    /* Check every 5 seconds */

DO WHILE wait_time < max_wait
   CALL OUTTRAP 'STAT.'
   "STATUS" jobnum
   CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'
   
   /* Check if job is still active */
   active = 0
   DO j = 1 TO STAT.0
      IF POS('EXECUTING', STAT.j) > 0 THEN active = 1
      IF POS('INPUT', STAT.j) > 0 THEN active = 1
   END
   
   IF \active THEN DO
      SAY 'Job' jobnum 'completed'
      /* Get return code from output */
      CALL OUTTRAP 'OUT.'
      "OUTPUT" jobnum "(PRINT)"
      CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'
      LEAVE
   END
   
   /* Wait and retry */
   CALL SYSCALLS 'ON'
   ADDRESS SYSCALL 'sleep' interval
   wait_time = wait_time + interval
   SAY 'Waiting...' wait_time 'seconds'
END

IF wait_time >= max_wait THEN
   SAY 'Timeout waiting for job' jobnum

EXIT 0
```

Write REXX to dynamically allocate and create a new dataset on z/OS

Here's REXX to dynamically allocate and create a new dataset:

```rexx
/* REXX - Dynamically create a new dataset */
ARG dsname

IF dsname = '' THEN DO
   SAY 'Usage: NEWDS dataset.name'
   EXIT 4
END

/* Check if dataset already exists */
IF SYSDSN("'"dsname"'") = 'OK' THEN DO
   SAY 'Dataset' dsname 'already exists'
   EXIT 4
END

/* Allocate new sequential dataset */
"ALLOC F(NEWFILE) DA('"dsname"') NEW CATALOG",
"  SPACE(5,5) TRACKS",
"  LRECL(80) RECFM(F,B) BLKSIZE(8000)",
"  DSORG(PS)"

IF RC \= 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Allocation failed, RC=' RC
   EXIT 8
END

SAY 'Dataset' dsname 'created successfully'

/* Write initial data */
LINE.1 = '* Dataset created by REXX on' DATE() TIME()
LINE.2 = '* '
LINE.0 = 2

"EXECIO" LINE.0 "DISKW NEWFILE (STEM LINE. FINIS)"

/* Free the allocation */
"FREE F(NEWFILE)"

/* Verify with LISTDSI */
result = LISTDSI("'"dsname"'")
IF result = 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Verification:'
   SAY '  Name:' SYSDSNAME
   SAY '  Volume:' SYSVOLUME
   SAY '  RECFM:' SYSRECFM
   SAY '  LRECL:' SYSLRECL
   SAY '  BLKSIZE:' SYSBLKSIZE
   SAY '  Space:' SYSALLOC 'tracks allocated'
END

EXIT 0
```

Write REXX to copy members between PDS libraries on z/OS

Here's REXX to copy members between PDS libraries:

```rexx
/* REXX - Copy PDS members between libraries */
ARG source_pds target_pds member_pattern

IF source_pds = '' | target_pds = '' THEN DO
   SAY 'Usage: COPYMBR source.pds target.pds [member_pattern]'
   SAY '       member_pattern: optional, e.g., ABC* or specific member'
   EXIT 4
END

IF member_pattern = '' THEN member_pattern = '*'

/* Verify source PDS exists */
IF SYSDSN("'"source_pds"'") \= 'OK' THEN DO
   SAY 'Source PDS not found:' source_pds
   EXIT 8
END

/* Allocate source and target */
"ALLOC F(INPDS) DA('"source_pds"') SHR REUSE"
IF RC \= 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Cannot allocate source:' source_pds
   EXIT 8
END

"ALLOC F(OUTPDS) DA('"target_pds"') SHR REUSE"
IF RC \= 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Cannot allocate target:' target_pds
   "FREE F(INPDS)"
   EXIT 8
END

/* Get member list from source */
CALL OUTTRAP 'MBR.'
"LISTDS '"source_pds"' MEMBERS"
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

/* Parse member names (skip header lines) */
copy_count = 0
in_members = 0

DO i = 1 TO MBR.0
   line = STRIP(MBR.i)
   
   /* Detect start of member list */
   IF POS('--MEMBERS--', TRANSLATE(line)) > 0 THEN DO
      in_members = 1
      ITERATE
   END
   
   IF in_members & line \= '' THEN DO
      member = WORD(line, 1)
      
      /* Check if member matches pattern */
      IF member_pattern = '*' | ,
         ABBREV(member, STRIP(member_pattern,'T','*')) THEN DO
         
         /* Copy this member */
         CALL CopyMember source_pds, target_pds, member
         IF RESULT = 0 THEN copy_count = copy_count + 1
      END
   END
END

/* Cleanup */
"FREE F(INPDS)"
"FREE F(OUTPDS)"

SAY 'Copied' copy_count 'members from' source_pds 'to' target_pds
EXIT 0

/*--------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CopyMember: PROCEDURE
/*--------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   ARG src_pds, tgt_pds, mbr_name
   
   /* Read source member */
   "ALLOC F(SRCMBR) DA('"src_pds"("mbr_name")') SHR REUSE"
   IF RC \= 0 THEN RETURN 8
   
   "EXECIO * DISKR SRCMBR (STEM DATA. FINIS)"
   read_rc = RC
   "FREE F(SRCMBR)"
   
   IF read_rc \= 0 & read_rc \= 2 THEN RETURN 8
   
   /* Write to target member */
   "ALLOC F(TGTMBR) DA('"tgt_pds"("mbr_name")') SHR REUSE"
   IF RC \= 0 THEN RETURN 8
   
   "EXECIO" DATA.0 "DISKW TGTMBR (STEM DATA. FINIS)"
   write_rc = RC
   "FREE F(TGTMBR)"
   
   IF write_rc = 0 THEN
      SAY '  Copied:' mbr_name '(' DATA.0 'records)'
   
   RETURN write_rc
```

Write REXX to display SMF record information on z/OS

Here's REXX to query SMF (System Management Facilities) status and configuration:

```rexx
/* REXX - Display SMF information */
SAY COPIES('=', 60)
SAY 'SMF System Status Report'
SAY 'Generated:' DATE() TIME()
SAY COPIES('=', 60)
SAY ''

/* Get SMF status via operator command */
CALL OUTTRAP 'SMF.'
ADDRESS TSO "CONSOLE ACTIVATE"
ADDRESS TSO "CONSOLE SYSCMD('D SMF')" 
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

SAY 'SMF Status:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)
DO i = 1 TO SMF.0
   IF SMF.i \= '' THEN SAY '  ' SMF.i
END

/* Get SMF options */
SAY ''
CALL OUTTRAP 'OPT.'
ADDRESS TSO "CONSOLE SYSCMD('D SMF,O')"
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

SAY 'SMF Recording Options:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)
DO i = 1 TO OPT.0
   IF OPT.i \= '' THEN SAY '  ' OPT.i
END

/* Check SMF datasets */
SAY ''
SAY 'SMF Datasets:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)

/* Common SMF dataset patterns */
smf_patterns = 'SYS1.MAN* SMF.* SYS1.SMF*'

DO i = 1 TO WORDS(smf_patterns)
   pattern = WORD(smf_patterns, i)
   CALL OUTTRAP 'DSN.'
   "LISTCAT ENT('"pattern"') NAME"
   CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'
   
   DO j = 1 TO DSN.0
      IF POS('NONVSAM', DSN.j) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR DSN.j . '---' dsname
         dsname = STRIP(dsname)
         IF dsname \= '' THEN DO
            /* Get dataset info */
            result = LISTDSI("'"dsname"'")
            IF result = 0 THEN
               SAY '  ' LEFT(dsname,44) SYSUSED'/'SYSALLOC 'tracks'
         END
      END
   END
END

SAY ''
SAY COPIES('=', 60)
SAY 'End of SMF Report'
SAY COPIES('=', 60)

EXIT 0
```

Note: Some commands require appropriate RACF authority. For production use, you may need:
- CONSOLE authority for operator commands
- READ access to SMF datasets
- OPERATIONS or equivalent for D SMF commands
Write REXX to parse and display RACF user information

Here's REXX to query and display RACF user information:

```rexx
/* REXX - Display RACF user information */
ARG userid

IF userid = '' THEN userid = SYSVAR('SYSUID')

SAY COPIES('=', 60)
SAY 'RACF User Profile:' userid
SAY 'Report generated:' DATE() TIME()
SAY COPIES('=', 60)
SAY ''

/* Get LISTUSER output */
CALL OUTTRAP 'USER.'
"LISTUSER" userid "OMVS NORACF"
lu_rc = RC
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

IF lu_rc \= 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Cannot list user' userid '- RC=' lu_rc
   SAY 'You may not have authority to view this user.'
   EXIT 8
END

/* Parse and display user information */
SAY 'Basic Information:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)

DO i = 1 TO USER.0
   line = USER.i
   
   /* Extract key fields */
   SELECT
      WHEN POS('USER=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'USER=' uname . 'NAME=' fullname
         SAY '  User ID:' STRIP(uname)
         IF fullname \= '' THEN SAY '  Name:' STRIP(fullname)
      END
      WHEN POS('OWNER=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'OWNER=' owner . 'CREATED=' created .
         SAY '  Owner:' STRIP(owner)
         SAY '  Created:' STRIP(created)
      END
      WHEN POS('DEFAULT-GROUP=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'DEFAULT-GROUP=' defgrp .
         SAY '  Default Group:' STRIP(WORD(defgrp,1))
      END
      WHEN POS('PASSDATE=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'PASSDATE=' passdate . 'PASS-INTERVAL=' passint .
         SAY '  Password Date:' STRIP(passdate)
         SAY '  Password Interval:' STRIP(WORD(passint,1)) 'days'
      END
      WHEN POS('ATTRIBUTES=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'ATTRIBUTES=' attrs
         SAY '  Attributes:' STRIP(attrs)
      END
      WHEN POS('UID=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'UID=' uid .
         SAY '  OMVS UID:' STRIP(WORD(uid,1))
      END
      WHEN POS('HOME=', line) > 0 THEN DO
         PARSE VAR line . 'HOME=' homedir
         SAY '  Home Dir:' STRIP(homedir)
      END
      OTHERWISE NOP
   END
END

/* Get group connections */
SAY ''
SAY 'Group Connections:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)

CALL OUTTRAP 'GRP.'
"LISTUSER" userid "NORACF"
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

DO i = 1 TO GRP.0
   line = GRP.i
   IF POS('GROUP=', line) > 0 & POS('CONNECT-', line) > 0 THEN DO
      PARSE VAR line . 'GROUP=' grpname . 'AUTH=' auth .
      SAY '  ' LEFT(STRIP(WORD(grpname,1)),12) 'AUTH=' STRIP(WORD(auth,1))
   END
END

/* Get dataset access (sample) */
SAY ''
SAY 'Recent Dataset Access (sample):'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)

CALL OUTTRAP 'ACC.'
"SEARCH CLASS(DATASET) USER("userid") CLIST"
search_rc = RC
CALL OUTTRAP 'OFF'

IF search_rc = 0 THEN DO
   count = 0
   DO i = 1 TO MIN(ACC.0, 10)  /* Show first 10 */
      IF ACC.i \= '' THEN DO
         SAY '  ' ACC.i
         count = count + 1
      END
   END
   IF ACC.0 > 10 THEN SAY '  ... and' (ACC.0 - 10) 'more'
END
ELSE
   SAY '  (No dataset permits found or no search authority)'

SAY ''
SAY COPIES('=', 60)
EXIT 0
```
Write REXX to compare two datasets and show differences

Here's REXX to compare two datasets and display differences:

```rexx
/* REXX - Compare two datasets */
ARG dsn1 dsn2 options

IF dsn1 = '' | dsn2 = '' THEN DO
   SAY 'Usage: COMPARE dsn1 dsn2 [BRIEF|FULL]'
   EXIT 4
END

IF options = '' THEN options = 'BRIEF'

SAY COPIES('=', 70)
SAY 'Dataset Comparison Report'
SAY COPIES('=', 70)
SAY 'Dataset 1:' dsn1
SAY 'Dataset 2:' dsn2
SAY 'Generated:' DATE() TIME()
SAY COPIES('=', 70)
SAY ''

/* Verify both datasets exist */
IF SYSDSN("'"dsn1"'") \= 'OK' THEN DO
   SAY 'Dataset 1 not found:' dsn1
   EXIT 8
END

IF SYSDSN("'"dsn2"'") \= 'OK' THEN DO
   SAY 'Dataset 2 not found:' dsn2
   EXIT 8
END

/* Read first dataset */
"ALLOC F(FILE1) DA('"dsn1"') SHR REUSE"
"EXECIO * DISKR FILE1 (STEM D1. FINIS)"
"FREE F(FILE1)"

/* Read second dataset */
"ALLOC F(FILE2) DA('"dsn2"') SHR REUSE"
"EXECIO * DISKR FILE2 (STEM D2. FINIS)"
"FREE F(FILE2)"

SAY 'Records in' dsn1':' D1.0
SAY 'Records in' dsn2':' D2.0
SAY ''

/* Compare records */
max_lines = MAX(D1.0, D2.0)
diff_count = 0
match_count = 0
only_in_1 = 0
only_in_2 = 0

DO i = 1 TO max_lines
   /* Get records (empty if past end) */
   IF i <= D1.0 THEN rec1 = D1.i
   ELSE rec1 = ''
   
   IF i <= D2.0 THEN rec2 = D2.i
   ELSE rec2 = ''
   
   /* Compare */
   SELECT
      WHEN rec1 = rec2 THEN DO
         match_count = match_count + 1
      END
      WHEN i > D1.0 THEN DO
         only_in_2 = only_in_2 + 1
         IF options = 'FULL' THEN DO
            SAY 'Line' i ': Only in dataset 2'
            SAY '  >' SUBSTR(rec2, 1, 72)
         END
      END
      WHEN i > D2.0 THEN DO
         only_in_1 = only_in_1 + 1
         IF options = 'FULL' THEN DO
            SAY 'Line' i ': Only in dataset 1'
            SAY '  <' SUBSTR(rec1, 1, 72)
         END
      END
      OTHERWISE DO
         diff_count = diff_count + 1
         IF options = 'FULL' THEN DO
            SAY 'Line' i ': DIFFERENT'
            SAY '  <' SUBSTR(rec1, 1, 72)
            SAY '  >' SUBSTR(rec2, 1, 72)
            /* Show first difference position */
            DO j = 1 TO MIN(LENGTH(rec1), LENGTH(rec2))
               IF SUBSTR(rec1,j,1) \= SUBSTR(rec2,j,1) THEN DO
                  SAY '   First diff at column' j
                  LEAVE
               END
            END
            SAY ''
         END
      END
   END
END

/* Summary */
SAY COPIES('-', 40)
SAY 'Comparison Summary:'
SAY COPIES('-', 40)
SAY '  Matching lines:' match_count
SAY '  Different lines:' diff_count
SAY '  Only in dataset 1:' only_in_1
SAY '  Only in dataset 2:' only_in_2
SAY ''

IF diff_count = 0 & only_in_1 = 0 & only_in_2 = 0 THEN
   SAY 'RESULT: Datasets are IDENTICAL'
ELSE
   SAY 'RESULT: Datasets are DIFFERENT'

SAY COPIES('=', 70)
EXIT 0
```
